Title.description: Translation key for the chapter's title, drawn at the top of the puzzle list

Name.description: Translation key for the chapter's name, drawn under the title

Location.description: Translation key for the chapter's location, shown at the top center

Items.description: The individual campaign entries, be they puzzles, pages, or cutscenes

Background.description: Path to the background for this chapter

LockedIcon.description: Path to the chapter selector sector when this chapter is locked

UnlockedIcon.description: Path to the chapter selector sector when this chapter is unlocked

HoverIcon.description: Path to the chapter selector sector when this chapter is hovered over

GemIcon.description: Path to the chapter selector gem

ButtonOffset.description: Where the chapter's button hit detection lands relative to the bottom left corner of the chapter selector

Alignment.description: The position the chapter list is placed

Components.description: The ids for components to be applied to this chapter
